title: Finite-support two-sided Duhamel history bound from the full Q3 character envelope
question: Can the registered full Q3 static second-commutator envelope be inserted into an exact finite-member two-sided Duhamel remainder estimate for a fixed two-site configuration-character word while keeping product, modular and shape costs explicit?

finite_fixture.source_scope: registered finite periodic Q3 volumes at fixed beta, compact sources, fixed two-site support and declared amplitudes

model.word: W_aS=exp(i*sum_(x in S) a_x*q_x/hbar) with |S|=2 and the declared amplitudes
model.static_input: EXP-001152 supplies a complete registered-family kinetic-plus-force fourth-moment envelope for the local character double commutator
model.multi_support_extension: For commuting site momenta and configuration forces, |sum c_x u_x|^4<=|S|^3 sum |c_x|^4 |u_x|^4 and the l1 force triangle give an explicit finite-support envelope
model.safe_force_step: sqrt(G_force4)<=G_force4 for G_force4>=1 is used only to keep the multi-support coefficient rational and deliberately loose
model.two_orientation_bound: N_beta(R_T^+(W)-R_T^-(W))^2<=T^4*B_word by the seminorm triangle inequality
model.product_cost: EXP-001150 gives same-form 81/4 and cross-form 1701/4 for the declared bounded C1 factor product; these costs are recorded but not silently used as an unbounded history theorem
model.qft_role: This is a finite-member two-sided history interface only; modular derivatives, volume comparison, exhaustion and common alpha remain separate gates

adversarial_review.check: The full force coefficient is read from EXP-001152 and its registered finite periodic compact-source scope is checked; no sharper unregistered coefficient is substituted.
The |S|^3 fourth-power inequality is applied to commuting site momenta and the support cost remains explicit.
The rational force envelope uses sqrt(G)<=G only after checking G>=1 and is labelled deliberately loose.
Positive and negative time kernels are evaluated separately with the same finite Gibbs isometry; no time-sign identification of the infinite-volume dynamics is inferred.
The two-orientation difference pays the full triangle factor and is not identified with a one-sided remainder.
The EXP-001150 bounded-C1 product costs are recorded as interface data only; unbounded polynomial products and history closure remain open.
No bound for delta_H R or a modular multiplier is inserted; modular transfer remains an explicit false scope flag.
The result is one fixed support and one registered finite-member family; no pairwise-volume or all-shape Cauchy conclusion is drawn.
R323 checks exact rational arithmetic and scope markers only, not unbounded domains, Gibbs traces or thermodynamic limits.
Finite-time remainder control is not common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

lean_crosscheck.role: R323 checks exact rational composition and finite-time scaling only; it does not formalize operator domains, Gibbs isometry or limits.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed two-site configuration-character word has an explicit finite-member positive-time and negative-time Duhamel remainder bound, plus a two-orientation difference bound, using the registered full Q3 static envelope.
qft_interface.open: Modular derivatives, four-context history, factorial incidence, volume-uniform direct D/delta-D Cauchy, unbounded products, exhaustion, group law, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-member two-sided Duhamel interface for a fixed two-site word; deliberately not a thermodynamic history theorem.
next_action: Use the finite-time seed as the base case for a four-context partial-history recurrence; prove or refute a volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform product/modular response coefficient before any exhaustion or common-alpha promotion.
no_overclaim: Only the declared fixed-support finite-member Duhamel remainder and two-orientation triangle bounds are closed. This does not establish actual Q3 four-context history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
